subject: Silvertip Diagnostics: private VPC hot-path — p95 spike, decode errors & proposed fallback
messages:
From: Ethan Brewer <ethan.brewer@silvertipdx.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: oncall@silvertipdx.com
Date: 2028-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected p95 jump + decode errors on our private VPC cluster

Jordan —

We started seeing a large increase in p95 latency and a corresponding rise in decode errors on our private VPC deployment (us-east-1) starting around 01:20 UTC. Overall throughput is down ~30% and a subset of requests return 503 / "decode_failed". Our SLOs are impacted and customers are noticing degraded inference latency.

Quick details:
- Affected: silvertip-prod-cluster-7 (private VPC)
- Symptom: p95 from ~220ms -> ~1.2s; p99 occasionally >3.5s
- Errors: decode_failed (internal runtime), 503 during cold batches, intermittent OOM traces in some containers
- Impact: customer-facing inference pipelines slowed; one customer reported timeouts in their orchestration

I've attached the top-level perf traces and a short annotated core dump. Oncall has pushed the traces to the Drive link.

We need an urgent plan: are there recommended quick mitigations we can apply from your side (kernel flags, kv-cache invalidation, temporary route to hosted fallback) while we work on a root cause? If not resolved within 4 hours we'll need an exec sync — Marco (CTO) is copied.

--
Ethan Brewer
VP Product, Silvertip Diagnostics
ethan.brewer@silvertipdx.com
Attachments: silvertip_perf_traces_0516.tar.gz, svc-core-dump-annotated.txt

Date: 2028-05-16T09:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected p95 jump + decode errors on our private VPC cluster

Ethan —

Thanks for the quick heads up and the traces. We see the same spike in telemetry on our end. First-pass thoughts / immediate actions:

1) Can you confirm if you recently rolled any model version, quantization profile, or changed max-seq settings?
2) We'll request a short maintenance window (30–60m) to run the following:
   - rotate KV cache and clear prefix cache on the hot hosts
   - temporarily reduce auto-batch size for the runtime on that pool to lower decode contention
   - enable extra debug logging on two canary nodes
3) If those don't stop the errors, recommend a temporary fallback routing to our hosted compatible model (same family, slightly higher latency) as a last-resort to meet SLOs. This requires your approval because it means traffic leaving private VPC to hosted endpoints.

We're spinning up an internal warroom (invite to follow). Marissa, Vivek, Connor — can you take lead on the quick triage and kernel/jit tuning options? I'll coordinate with Silvertip for the fallback permission.

–Jordan
Jordan Blake

Subject: INTERNAL: Silvertip private VPC — triage plan and immediate actions

Team —

Forwarding Ethan's initial notes (below) + attachment. Plan of record for immediate triage (next 2 hours):

- Identify hot hosts in silvertip-prod-cluster-7 (Vivek) and isolate the top 10 longest-running calls. Collect full KV cache stats and batch timing.
- On two canary nodes (connor):
  * temporarily set batch_max_tokens = 512 -> 256
  * disable L2 kernel prefetch optimization (recent kernel jit knob) to test if the recent optimizer is regressing decode stability
  * rotate the KV prefix cache for the last 6 hours (prefix eviction)
- Marissa: prep comms for Silvertip execs; include cost/impact if we need hosted fallback. Also confirm whether any internal config changes were made on their side this morning.

Attachments I uploaded to the warroom folder: silvertip_perf_traces_0516.tar.gz, svc-core-dump-annotated.txt. I also created INF-4821 for tracking.

If tuning stabilizes within the hour we avoid fallback. If not, I need an explicit green light from Silvertip to route their traffic to the hosted compatible model (estimated incremental cost in the attached spreadsheet).

Thanks — quick updates in thread.

Subject: Re: Unexpected p95 jump + decode errors on our private VPC cluster — exec update and ask

Team / Silvertip execs —

Quick executive summary and ask after initial triage:

- Root cause (probable): surge of highly concurrent small requests from a partner integration amplified KV-cache contention on a subset of hosts. The runtime's recent L2 prefetch optimization appears to exacerbate decode memory pressure under this access pattern, leading to transient decode errors and a small number of OOMs.
- What we tried: rotated KV prefix cache on hot hosts; lowered batch_max_tokens on canaries; collected extended traces. Initial canaries saw p95 drop from ~1.2s -> ~480–600ms but some decode_failed persisted on one host.
- Immediate recommended next steps (requires Silvertip approval):
  1) Temporary fallback routing for ~30% of traffic to our hosted compatible variant for 4–8 hours while we push a small runtime patch (disable L2 prefetch + tighter memory caps). This preserves SLOs at an incremental cost (estimate in attached spreadsheet).
  2) If approved, engineering will roll the runtime flag in a staged canary -> 50% -> full rollout over 2 hours.

Ask: Silvertip please confirm by 17:00 PT if you approve fallback routing. If not approved we will continue deeper host-level debugging but risk continued customer impact.

References: INF-4821 (warroom), Drive traces: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSilvertipLogs
